SLE.note: Document states nothing on AI harms rules.
Document states nothing on government use of AI.
Document states nothing on sectoral AI.
A feasibility grant for hosting a regional data embassy is not AI computing; no AI model, dataset or facility is named.

facts.fact: AfDB says the ECOWAS Regional Data Embassy Initiative, which Sierra Leone championed and which ECOWAS heads of state approved, would create trusted cross-border hosting of critical government data while preserving national jurisdiction and ownership.

Minister Salima Monorma Bah said Sierra Leone championed the ECOWAS Regional Data Embassy Initiative through ECOWAS, which its ICT Council of Ministers endorsed, and AfDB granted US$750,000 for a feasibility assessment of Sierra Leone hosting it.
